title: Dev builds clobber the shared MCP discovery file
description: Dev instances bind mcp_port+1 (41415) to avoid colliding with the installed app, but both write the same <app-data>/mcp.json. A dev run rewrites it to 41415; after the dev app quits, the CLI and agents discover a dead port until the installed app restarts (hit live 2026-08-31: CLI errored against 41415 while nothing listened; installed app relaunch fixed it). Options: dev builds write mcp.dev.json and leave mcp.json alone, or discovery consumers fall back to the default port when the recorded pid is dead. Discovery already records pid.
close_reason: Fixed on main cabac45: dev builds write/remove mcp.dev.json instead of clobbering mcp.json; CLAUDE.md documents ALCHEMY_MCP_DISCOVERY for aiming the CLI at a dev build. Gates green; live run blocked by a concurrent pre-fix dev instance from another worktree (which demonstrated the bug once more).

title: Thread window labels through the remaining meta_step broadcasts
description: PR #29 windowed the Home Chat meta:// events (payload carries the window label; the store self-filters, src/lib/store.ts bindGlobalListeners). The global-tool flows in src-tauri/src/commands.rs (~7863-8042: add_urls_from_home, command routing 'Choosing a notebook'/'Checking for commands') still emit label-less meta_step broadcasts that every window accepts. Thread the asking window's label through those call chains so multi-window Home Chats are fully isolated.

title: Review and enable marketplace plugins
description:
The following plugin marketplaces have been configured for this project:

- beads-marketplace
- allbeads-marketplace
- claude-plugins-official-marketplace
- claude-code-marketplace
- skills-marketplace
- chrome-devtools-mcp-marketplace
- claude-skill-marketplace
- repomix-marketplace
- prose-marketplace

Consider which plugins would be useful for your workflow and enable them:

```bash
# List available plugins
claude plugin marketplace list

# Enable a plugin
claude plugin enable <plugin>@<marketplace>
```

Note: beads and allbeads plugins are enabled by default.
